integrity: The analytic proof derives each barycentric reproducing kernel, proves vertex maximality by convexity, handles zero asymptotic proportions with a second-moment bound, proves strict Schur-convexity by exponential symmetrization, and evaluates all extremal constants using elementary exponential and gamma integrals. The standalone verifier checks exact finite instances and closed-form constants, not the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Projection is onto the total-degree-one affine space, not the tensor-product polynomial space. The dimension-proportion asymptotic holds for fixed number of factors without a uniform remainder. The exact norm is a finite beta expectation rather than a simple closed form for arbitrary dimensions. Novelty remains conditional on available published and indexed literature; independent scientific audit was not performed.
title: Sharp aspect-ratio law for affine projections on products of simplices
